<<<M FILE packages/filament/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Filament\Contracts\Plugin;
use Vaulter\Filament\VaulterPlugin;

arch('all package code declares strict types')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Filament')
    ->toUseStrictTypes();

arch('the plugin implements the Filament plugin contract')
    ->expect(VaulterPlugin::class)
    ->toImplement(Plugin::class);

arch('no debug helpers leak into the package')
    ->expect(['dd', 'dump', 'ray', 'var_dump'])
    ->not->toBeUsed();

// Filament uses the public core/drive API; it never reaches into sibling engines.
arch('filament never depends on documents or media')
    ->expect('Vaulter\\Filament')
    ->not->toUse(['Vaulter\\Documents', 'Vaulter\\Media']);

// E5.1 / F-P4.3-01 — declarative form kept for discoverability/grep (`toUse('App')`);
// see the file-scan test below (and core's ArchTest.php) for why this namespace-graph
// form cannot itself observe a real "uses" edge in this dev/test environment.
arch('the package never depends on the host application (E5.1)')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Filament')
    ->not->toUse('App');

/**
 * E5.1 / F-P4.3-01 — vaulter-filament is an embeddable Laravel package: it must never
 * reach into the HOST application's namespace. File scan (not
 * `expect(...)->not->toUse('App')`) because `App\*` is never an autoloadable class in
 * the package's own dev/test environment (red-before proven on core's ArchTest.php).
 */
test('non-test src never references the host App namespace (E5.1, F-P4.3-01)', function (): void {
    $src = __DIR__.'/../../src';
    $offenders = [];

    /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
    $files = new RegexIterator(
        new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($src)),
        '/\.php$/',
    );

    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $contents = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());

        if ($contents === false) {
            continue;
        }

        $code = '';

        foreach (token_get_all($contents) as $token) {
            if (is_array($token) && in_array($token[0], [T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $code .= is_array($token) ? $token[1] : $token;
        }

        if (preg_match('/\\bApp\\\\/', $code) === 1) {
            $offenders[] = $file->getPathname();
        }
    }

    expect($offenders)->toBe([]);
});

/**
 * E3.1 / F-P4.3-02 — filament HAS its own package sub-namespace, so the public-API
 * boundary is enforceable at full strength here: `Support/` is internal
 * implementation detail and must never be referenced from outside `Vaulter\Filament`
 * itself (verified: no other package currently references `Vaulter\Filament\Support`).
 */
arch('internal namespaces are not used outside the package (E3.1)')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Filament\Support')
    ->toOnlyBeUsedIn('Vaulter\Filament');

/**
 * VLT-REL P2.2 — empty-surface guard for the 0.1.0 freeze. This package ships NO public
 * contract interface (`src/Contracts/**`), so the frozen surface records that emptiness:
 * an accidentally-added public contract (which would need its own snapshot freeze + a D#
 * per AMEND) reddens the build instead of slipping into the tag unfrozen. The sibling
 * packages with real contracts (core/drive/documents/azgard) carry PublicApiSnapshotTest.
 */
test('the package exposes no public contract surface (VLT-REL P2.2)', function (): void {
    $contractsDir = __DIR__.'/../../src/Contracts';
    $found = [];

    if (is_dir($contractsDir)) {
        /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
        $files = new RegexIterator(
            new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($contractsDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)),
            '/\.php$/',
        );

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $found[] = $file->getPathname();
        }
    }

    expect($found)->toBe([]);
});

arch('DB facade is routed through VaulterDatabase (AD25)')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Filament')
    ->not->toUse('Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB');

// D35: production code cannot import fixtures or other Testing namespace classes.
test('production src never imports a Testing namespace', function (): void {
    $src = __DIR__.'/../../src';
    $offenders = [];

    /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
    $files = new RegexIterator(
        new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($src, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)),
        '/\.php$/',
    );

    foreach ($files as $file) {
        // A shipped Testing helper is allowed to depend on other testing helpers.
        if (str_contains($file->getPathname(), DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR.'Testing'.DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR)) {
            continue;
        }

        $contents = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());

        if ($contents === false) {
            continue;
        }

        foreach (token_get_all($contents) as $token) {
            if (!is_array($token) || !in_array($token[0], [T_NAME_QUALIFIED, T_NAME_FULLY_QUALIFIED, T_NAME_RELATIVE], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (in_array('Testing', explode('\\', $token[1]), true)) {
                $offenders[] = $file->getPathname();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    expect($offenders)->toBe([]);
});

<<<M FILE packages/filament/tests/Feature/ResourceListingScopeTest.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Vaulter\Enums\Access\GrantLevel;
use Vaulter\Filament\Resources\ActivityResource;
use Vaulter\Filament\Resources\DriveResource;
use Vaulter\Filament\Resources\NodeGrantResource;
use Vaulter\Filament\Resources\NodeShareResource;
use Vaulter\Filament\Tests\Fixtures\DriveBuilder;

/*
 * F-P1.10-01 (Major) — the four previously-unscoped Filament resources
 * (Storage/NodeGrant/NodeShare/Activity) now narrow getEloquentQuery() to the
 * acting admin's grant-reachable candidate set (PanelAccessScope), mirroring
 * NodeResource's existing pattern. Each pair below is red-before-fix (D7): on
 * the pre-fix code every "stranger sees nothing" assertion FAILS (the repro
 * `plans/AUDIT-VLT/artifacts/repro/P1.10/FilamentSurfaceReproTest.php` demonstrates
 * exactly this — a zero-grant actor saw every row of every owner).
 */

it('DriveResource lists a storage the acting admin can reach and hides one it cannot (F-P1.10-01)', function (): void {
    $owner = DriveBuilder::user(1);
    $reachable = DriveBuilder::storage();
    $unreachable = DriveBuilder::storage();

    $this->actingAs($owner);
    DriveBuilder::grant($reachable->rootNode()->first(), $owner, level: GrantLevel::Owner);

    $ids = DriveResource::getEloquentQuery()->pluck('id')->all();

    expect($ids)->toContain($reachable->getKey())
        ->and($ids)->not->toContain($unreachable->getKey());

    // A stranger with ZERO grants anywhere sees NEITHER storage.
    $stranger = DriveBuilder::user(99);
    $this->actingAs($stranger);

    $strangerIds = DriveResource::getEloquentQuery()->pluck('id')->all();

    expect($strangerIds)->toBe([]);
});

it('NodeGrantResource lists a grant on a reachable node and hides one on an unreachable node (F-P1.10-01)', function (): void {
    $owner = DriveBuilder::user(1);
    $storage = DriveBuilder::storage();
    $reachable = DriveBuilder::folder($storage, 'Owned');
    $unreachable = DriveBuilder::folder($storage, 'NotOwned');

    $this->actingAs($owner);
    $ownGrant = DriveBuilder::grant($reachable, $owner, level: GrantLevel::Owner);

    // A grant that belongs to a DIFFERENT subject on a node the acting owner
    // cannot reach at all.
    $stranger = DriveBuilder::user(2);
    $foreignGrant = DriveBuilder::grant($unreachable, $stranger, level: GrantLevel::Owner);

    $ids = NodeGrantResource::getEloquentQuery()->pluck('id')->all();

    expect($ids)->toContain($ownGrant->getKey())
        ->and($ids)->not->toContain($foreignGrant->getKey());

    // A zero-grant stranger sees NEITHER grant row.
    $this->actingAs(DriveBuilder::user(99));

    expect(NodeGrantResource::getEloquentQuery()->pluck('id')->all())->toBe([]);
});

it('NodeShareResource lists a share on a reachable node and hides one on an unreachable node (F-P1.10-01)', function (): void {
    $owner = DriveBuilder::user(1);
    $this->actingAs($owner);

    $storage = DriveBuilder::storage();
    $reachable = DriveBuilder::folder($storage, 'ShareHost');
    DriveBuilder::grant($reachable, $owner, level: GrantLevel::Owner);

    NodeShareResource::createFromData([
        'node_id' => $reachable->getKey(),
        'level' => GrantLevel::Reader->value,
        'permissions' => 1,
    ]);

    // A stranger with zero grants anywhere sees NO share row.
    $this->actingAs(DriveBuilder::user(99));

    expect(NodeShareResource::getEloquentQuery()->get())->toBeEmpty();

    // The owning admin still sees their own share.
    $this->actingAs($owner);

    $rows = NodeShareResource::getEloquentQuery()->get();

    expect($rows)->not->toBeEmpty()
        ->and($rows->first()->node_id)->toBe($reachable->getKey());
});

it('ActivityResource lists activity targeting a reachable node and hides a foreign owner\'s activity (F-P1.10-01)', function (): void {
    $owner = DriveBuilder::user(1);
    $storage = DriveBuilder::storage();
    $reachable = DriveBuilder::folder($storage, 'Loud');

    $foreignStorage = DriveBuilder::storage();
    DriveBuilder::folder($foreignStorage, 'AlsoLoud'); // writes a foreign activity row

    $this->actingAs($owner);
    DriveBuilder::grant($reachable, $owner, level: GrantLevel::Owner);

    $targetIds = ActivityResource::getEloquentQuery()->pluck('target_id')->all();

    expect($targetIds)->toContain($reachable->getKey());

    // A zero-grant stranger sees NO activity at all.
    $this->actingAs(DriveBuilder::user(99));

    expect(ActivityResource::getEloquentQuery()->count())->toBe(0);
});

<<<M FILE packages/media/src/Console/GcBlobsCommand.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Media\Console;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Vaulter\Media\Cas\BlobGarbageCollector;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;

/**
 * Two-phase, race-safe blob garbage collection (H.3). ACL-blind, system context:
 * mark unreferenced committed blobs as tombstoned (with a grace deadline), then
 * sweep tombstoned blobs past grace to a physical delete. --pending also clears
 * crashed-staging PENDING rows. The grace window comes from config('vaulter.gc.
 * grace_hours') (floored at 1h) unless --grace overrides it.
 */
final class GcBlobsCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'vaulter:blobs:gc
        {--grace= : Override the GC grace window in hours (floored at 1h)}
        {--pending : Also sweep crashed-staging PENDING blobs}';

    protected $description = 'Garbage-collect unreferenced Vaulter blobs (two-phase, race-safe — H.3)';

    public function handle(BlobGarbageCollector $collector): int
    {
        $grace = $this->graceOption();

        $result = $collector->collect(graceHours: $grace);

        $this->components->info(
            "Tombstoned {$result['tombstoned']}, swept {$result['swept']}, skipped {$result['skipped']} ".
            '(grace '.Config::gcGraceHours($grace).'h).',
        );

        if ($this->option('pending')) {
            $pending = $collector->sweepPending(graceHours: $grace);

            $this->components->info("Pending sweep: swept {$pending['swept']}, skipped {$pending['skipped']}.");
        }

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function graceOption(): int
    {
        $value = $this->option('grace');

        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 0;
    }
}

<<<M FILE packages/media/src/Console/ReconcileBlobsCommand.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Media\Console;

use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Vaulter\Media\Cas\BlobReconciler;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;

/**
 * Rebuild the ref_count cache from the v_file_revision_blobs edge counts — the real
 * liveness truth (H.3) — and report integrity hazards: dangling rows (a committed
 * blob whose canonical object is missing on disk). With --orphans it ALSO walks the
 * disk for the inverse hazard — orphan objects (bytes on disk with no blob row),
 * reporting them by default and DELETING them only under --prune. The default run
 * (no flags) is unchanged: row-side reconcile only.
 *
 * Two capability caveats (the reconciler enforces them, this command surfaces them):
 *  - The disk-walk needs a CAS driver that can enumerate the disk; a non-listable
 *    driver (e.g. S3 / non-FilesystemAdapter) is reported "listing unsupported" and
 *    skipped, not failed.
 *  - --prune deletes bytes under a write-less critical section, which only serialises
 *    against a concurrent commit on PostgreSQL/MySQL. On SQLite pruning is REFUSED
 *    (orphans are still detected + reported); run report-only there, or prune on the
 *    production DB.
 *
 * EXIT: report-only (or prune-refused) that FINDS orphans exits FAILURE so cron/CI
 * sees the hazard; a prune that cleaned them, and a clean run, exit SUCCESS.
 */
final class ReconcileBlobsCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'vaulter:blobs:reconcile
        {--orphans : Also walk the disk for orphan objects (bytes with no blob row)}
        {--disk= : The disk to scan for orphans (defaults to the configured CAS disk)}
        {--orphan-grace= : Override the orphan grace window in hours (floored at 1h)}
        {--prune : DELETE the orphans found (PostgreSQL/MySQL only; refused on sqlite). Default: report only}';

    protected $description = 'Rebuild blob ref_count from edge counts and report dangling rows; optionally disk-walk for orphan objects (H.3)';

    public function handle(BlobReconciler $reconciler): int
    {
        $report = $reconciler->reconcile();

        $this->components->info(
            "Reconciled {$report['reconciled']} blobs, corrected {$report['changed']} ref_count caches.",
        );

        $exit = self::SUCCESS;

        if ($report['dangling'] !== []) {
            $this->components->warn(
                'Dangling rows (committed blob, missing object): '.implode(', ', $report['dangling']),
            );

            $exit = self::FAILURE;
        } else {
            $this->components->info('No dangling rows detected.');
        }

        if ($this->option('orphans')) {
            return $this->walkOrphans(reconciler: $reconciler, exit: $exit);
        }

        if ($this->option('prune')) {
            $this->components->warn('--prune has no effect without --orphans; nothing pruned.');
        }

        return $exit;
    }

    private function walkOrphans(BlobReconciler $reconciler, int $exit): int
    {
        $disk = $this->diskOption();
        $grace = $this->orphanGraceOption();
        $prune = (bool) $this->option('prune');

        $result = $reconciler->sweepOrphans(disk: $disk, graceHours: $grace, prune: $prune);

        // The active CAS driver cannot enumerate the disk (e.g. S3 /
        // non-FilesystemAdapter) — refuse the walk cleanly rather than fail; the
        // row-side reconcile result above still stands.
        if (!$result['listingSupported']) {
            $this->components->warn(
                'Orphan walk: the active CAS driver does not support listing — skipped.',
            );

            return $exit;
        }

        // --prune was asked for but this driver does not serialise the write-less
        // prune against a concurrent commit (SQLite): we DETECTED orphans but
        // refused to delete them. Tell the operator where pruning is safe.
        $pruneRefused = $prune && !$result['pruneSupported'];
        $effectivelyPruning = $prune && $result['pruneSupported'];

        $mode = $effectivelyPruning ? 'pruned' : 'report-only';

        $this->components->info(
            "Orphan walk ({$mode}): scanned {$result['scanned']}, found ".count($result['orphans']).
            ", pruned {$result['pruned']}, skipped {$result['skipped']} ".
            '(disk '.($disk ?? Config::defaultDisk()).', grace '.Config::orphanGraceHours($grace).'h).',
        );

        if ($pruneRefused) {
            $this->components->warn(
                'Orphan pruning needs PostgreSQL/MySQL (the delete must serialize against '.
                'concurrent commits); on sqlite use report-only or run on the production DB.',
            );
        }

        if ($result['orphans'] === []) {
            return $exit;
        }

        // Orphans surfaced but not deleted (report-only, or prune refused on this
        // driver) — list them and degrade the exit to FAILURE so cron/CI sees the
        // hazard (mirrors the dangling-row exit branch). A prune that cleaned them
        // all leaves $result['orphans'] non-empty yet pruned them; only the
        // not-actually-pruning paths fail the run.
        if (!$effectivelyPruning) {
            $this->components->warn(
                'Orphan objects (bytes with no blob row): '.implode(', ', $result['orphans']),
            );

            return self::FAILURE;
        }

        return $exit;
    }

    private function diskOption(): ?string
    {
        $value = $this->option('disk');

        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : null;
    }

    private function orphanGraceOption(): int
    {
        $value = $this->option('orphan-grace');

        return is_numeric($value) ? (int) $value : 0;
    }
}

<<<M FILE packages/media/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// The media package is strict-typed end to end.
arch('strict types')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Media')
    ->toUseStrictTypes();

// The CAS layer stays ACL-agnostic: nothing under Vaulter\Media may reach into the
// core access-control machinery. This is the structural guard behind decision D3
// (per-file ACL lives in core; media is a pure content-addressed blob layer).
arch('media never touches the access layer')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Media')
    ->not->toUse([
        'Vaulter\Access\AccessResolver',
        'Vaulter\Contracts\Access\GrantAuthoritativeDriver',
    ]);

// E5.1 / F-P4.3-01 — declarative form kept for discoverability/grep (`toUse('App')`);
// see the file-scan test below (and core's ArchTest.php) for why this namespace-graph
// form cannot itself observe a real "uses" edge in this dev/test environment.
arch('the package never depends on the host application (E5.1)')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Media')
    ->not->toUse('App');

/**
 * E5.1 / F-P4.3-01 — vaulter-media is an embeddable Laravel package: it must never
 * reach into the HOST application's namespace. File scan (not
 * `expect(...)->not->toUse('App')`) because `App\*` is never an autoloadable class in
 * the package's own dev/test environment (red-before proven on core's ArchTest.php).
 */
test('non-test src never references the host App namespace (E5.1, F-P4.3-01)', function (): void {
    $src = __DIR__.'/../../src';
    $offenders = [];

    /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
    $files = new RegexIterator(
        new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($src)),
        '/\.php$/',
    );

    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $contents = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());

        if ($contents === false) {
            continue;
        }

        $code = '';

        foreach (token_get_all($contents) as $token) {
            if (is_array($token) && in_array($token[0], [T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $code .= is_array($token) ? $token[1] : $token;
        }

        if (preg_match('/\\bApp\\\\/', $code) === 1) {
            $offenders[] = $file->getPathname();
        }
    }

    expect($offenders)->toBe([]);
});

/**
 * VLT-REL P2.2 — empty-surface guard for the 0.1.0 freeze. This package ships NO public
 * contract interface (`src/Contracts/**`), so the frozen surface records that emptiness:
 * an accidentally-added public contract (which would need its own snapshot freeze + a D#
 * per AMEND) reddens the build instead of slipping into the tag unfrozen. The sibling
 * packages with real contracts (core/drive/documents/azgard) carry PublicApiSnapshotTest.
 */
test('the package exposes no public contract surface (VLT-REL P2.2)', function (): void {
    $contractsDir = __DIR__.'/../../src/Contracts';
    $found = [];

    if (is_dir($contractsDir)) {
        /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
        $files = new RegexIterator(
            new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($contractsDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)),
            '/\.php$/',
        );

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $found[] = $file->getPathname();
        }
    }

    expect($found)->toBe([]);
});

arch('DB facade is routed through VaulterDatabase (AD25)')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Media')
    ->not->toUse('Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB');

// D35: production code cannot import fixtures or other Testing namespace classes.
test('production src never imports a Testing namespace', function (): void {
    $src = __DIR__.'/../../src';
    $offenders = [];

    /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
    $files = new RegexIterator(
        new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($src, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)),
        '/\.php$/',
    );

    foreach ($files as $file) {
        // A shipped Testing helper is allowed to depend on other testing helpers.
        if (str_contains($file->getPathname(), DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR.'Testing'.DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR)) {
            continue;
        }

        $contents = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());

        if ($contents === false) {
            continue;
        }

        foreach (token_get_all($contents) as $token) {
            if (!is_array($token) || !in_array($token[0], [T_NAME_QUALIFIED, T_NAME_FULLY_QUALIFIED, T_NAME_RELATIVE], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (in_array('Testing', explode('\\', $token[1]), true)) {
                $offenders[] = $file->getPathname();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    expect($offenders)->toBe([]);
});

<<<M FILE packages/media/tests/Cas/BlobCommandsTest.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\BlobStore;
use Vaulter\Enums\Cas\BlobStatus;
use Vaulter\Media\Tests\Cas\CasTestHelpers;
use Vaulter\ValueObjects\Cas\BlobScope;

/**
 * The CAS console commands wire the collector / reconciler to artisan (H.3): the
 * GC tombstones-then-sweeps and reconcile rebuilds ref_count and reports.
 */
beforeEach(function (): void {
    Storage::fake('local');
    config()->set('vaulter.dedup.scope', 'tenant');
    config()->set('vaulter.gc.grace_hours', 1);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:gc прогоняет обе фазы', function (): void {
    $store = app(BlobStore::class);

    $blob = $store->commit(CasTestHelpers::streamFor('via command'), scope: BlobScope::forUpload((string) config('vaulter.dedup.scope'), (string) 1, 'unused'));
    // Already tombstoned past grace → the sweep phase removes it.
    $blob->forceFill(['status' => BlobStatus::Tombstoned, 'delete_after_at' => now()->subDay()])->save();

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:gc')
        ->assertSuccessful();

    expect($blob->fresh()->status)->toBe(BlobStatus::Deleted);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:gc --pending подметает упавший staging', function (): void {
    $store = app(BlobStore::class);

    $blob = $store->commit(CasTestHelpers::streamFor('half upload'), scope: BlobScope::forUpload((string) config('vaulter.dedup.scope'), (string) 1, 'unused'));
    // A crashed staging: pending, old, no edge.
    $blob->forceFill(['status' => BlobStatus::Pending, 'first_seen_at' => now()->subDay()])->save();

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:gc', ['--pending' => true])
        ->assertSuccessful();

    expect($blob->fresh()->status)->toBe(BlobStatus::Deleted);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile корректирует ref_count и сообщает', function (): void {
    $store = app(BlobStore::class);

    $blob = $store->commit(CasTestHelpers::streamFor('reconcile cmd'), scope: BlobScope::forUpload((string) config('vaulter.dedup.scope'), (string) 1, 'unused'));
    $version = CasTestHelpers::makeVersion();
    $store->attach($version, $blob);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile')
        ->assertSuccessful();

    expect($blob->fresh()->ref_count)->toBe(1);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile падает, когда есть dangling-строка', function (): void {
    $blob = app(BlobStore::class)->commit(CasTestHelpers::streamFor('dangling cmd'), scope: BlobScope::forUpload((string) config('vaulter.dedup.scope'), (string) 1, 'unused'));

    Storage::disk('local')->delete($blob->storage_key);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile')
        ->assertFailed();
});

<<<M FILE packages/media/tests/Cas/BlobOrphanPruneTest.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\ContentStore;
use Vaulter\Enums\Cas\BlobStatus;
use Vaulter\Media\Cas\BlobReconciler;
use Vaulter\Media\Tests\Cas\CasTestHelpers;
use Vaulter\Media\Tests\Fixtures\Cas\PhantomListingContentStore;
use Vaulter\Models\Cas\Blob;
use Vaulter\ValueObjects\Cas\BlobScope;

/**
 * The DESTRUCTIVE orphan prune (master plan P4 #11 / H.3): physically deleting true
 * orphans under the per-(scope,sha256) lock. It is only safe on a driver whose lock
 * serialises a write-less critical section — PostgreSQL's advisory xact lock or
 * MySQL's FOR UPDATE — so on SQLite the prune is REFUSED (covered in
 * BlobOrphanSweepTest). These cases pin the actual deletion + the lock-then-recheck
 * concurrency guard + idempotency, and therefore run ONLY on pgsql.
 *
 * The project CI is sqlite (the base TestCase forces an in-memory sqlite connection),
 * so EVERY test here SKIPS unless the live connection is pgsql — they are ready for
 * the future pgsql job (master plan P4 #11 TODO). Run them with the suite pointed at
 * a Postgres connection to exercise the real delete path.
 */
beforeEach(function (): void {
    Storage::fake('local');
    config()->set('vaulter.dedup.scope', 'tenant');
    Carbon::setTestNow('2026-06-30 12:00:00');
})->skip(
    fn (): bool => DB::connection()->getDriverName() !== 'pgsql',
    'orphan prune is PG/MySQL-only; needs the pgsql CI job (master plan P4 #11).',
);

// 11. Actual prune deletes the bytes.
it('prune на pgsql реально удаляет байты осиротевшего объекта', function (): void {
    $orphanKey = CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'pg prune me', scope: 't1', ageHours: 48);

    $report = app(BlobReconciler::class)->sweepOrphans(disk: 'local', graceHours: 24, prune: true);

    expect($report['pruneSupported'])->toBeTrue()
        ->and($report['pruned'])->toBe(1)
        ->and($report['orphans'])->toBe([$orphanKey]);
    Storage::disk('local')->assertMissing($orphanKey);
});

// 11b. Command-level: a prune that cleaned everything exits SUCCESS.
it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphans --prune на pgsql очищает orphan и выходит SUCCESS', function (): void {
    $orphanKey = CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'pg cmd prune', scope: 't1', ageHours: 48);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile', ['--orphans' => true, '--prune' => true, '--orphan-grace' => 24])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('Orphan walk (pruned)')
        ->assertExitCode(Command::SUCCESS);

    Storage::disk('local')->assertMissing($orphanKey);
});

// 12. Concurrency / lock-then-recheck: a row that appears before the locked recheck
//     prevents the delete (the commit won the race for the content address).
it('lock-then-recheck на pgsql: строка, появившаяся до перепроверки под локом, спасает байты', function (): void {
    // A true parallel-connection interleave (commit racing the prune between the
    // cheap scan and the under-lock recheck) is impractical in a single-process
    // test. We pin the decisive invariant instead: the prune's under-lock probe
    // (findByStorageKey(lock: true)) is what gates the delete — so an owning row
    // present at recheck time means the bytes are NOT deleted.
    $orphanKey = CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'commit won', scope: 't1', ageHours: 48);

    // The "commit won" outcome: a committed row now owns this exact storage_key.
    // forceFill (P1.4/F-P1.5-04): Blob is fully guarded — bypassed here exactly
    // like BlobStoreRepository::insertCommitted() does.
    $winningBlob = new Blob;
    $winningBlob->forceFill([
        'tenant_id' => 1,
        'drive_id' => null,
        'hash_algo' => 'sha256',
        'sha256' => hash('sha256', 'commit won'),
        'size_bytes' => strlen('commit won'),
        'disk' => 'local',
        'storage_key' => $orphanKey,
        'status' => BlobStatus::Committed,
        'ref_count' => 0,
        'dedup_scope' => 'tenant',
        'scope_key' => 'tenant:1',
        'committed_at' => now(),
    ]);
    $winningBlob->save();

    $report = app(BlobReconciler::class)->sweepOrphans(disk: 'local', graceHours: 24, prune: true);

    // Owned ⇒ never an orphan, never pruned; the committed bytes survive.
    expect($report['orphans'])->toBe([])
        ->and($report['pruned'])->toBe(0);
    Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($orphanKey);
});

// 13. Missing object on prune is idempotent: an object listed + past grace at scan
//     time but GONE by the time the under-lock physical delete fires (a concurrent
//     remove) must NOT throw — the delete is a harmless no-op.
//
//     A true between-scan-and-delete vanish is not single-process-reproducible against
//     the real disk (listKeys is a snapshot generator), so we drive it with a fixture
//     that lists a PHANTOM key (old mtime, no bytes): detection classifies it as an
//     orphan, then the prune's delete no-ops over the absent object.
it('prune на pgsql идемпотентен: исчезнувший до удаления объект не бросает (phantom listing)', function (): void {
    $phantomKey = app(ContentStore::class)->keyFor(scope: BlobScope::fromSegment('t1'), sha256: hash('sha256', 'phantom'));

    app()->instance(ContentStore::class, new PhantomListingContentStore(
        phantomKey: $phantomKey,
        phantomMtime: now()->subHours(48)->getTimestamp(),
    ));

    $report = app(BlobReconciler::class)->sweepOrphans(disk: 'local', graceHours: 24, prune: true);

    // No exception; the phantom is found as an orphan and its delete is a no-op.
    expect($report['orphans'])->toBe([$phantomKey])
        ->and($report['pruned'])->toBe(1);
});

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

<<<M FILE packages/media/tests/Cas/ReconcileBlobsOrphanCommandTest.php>>>
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\ContentStore;
use Vaulter\Media\Tests\Cas\CasTestHelpers;
use Vaulter\Media\Tests\Fixtures\Cas\NonListableContentStore;

/**
 * The vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphans console wiring (master plan P4 #11 / H.3):
 * the command surfaces the orphan disk-walk and maps its result to an exit code so
 * cron/CI sees the hazard. The contract pinned here:
 *
 *  - --orphans that FINDS an orphan (report-only) exits FAILURE and lists it;
 *  - --orphans --prune on sqlite is REFUSED (prints the "needs PostgreSQL/MySQL"
 *    guidance), leaves the bytes, and still exits FAILURE (the orphan is still there);
 *  - a clean disk exits SUCCESS;
 *  - a non-listable driver is reported "listing unsupported", not failed.
 *
 * Time is frozen so the grace arithmetic is deterministic.
 */
beforeEach(function (): void {
    Storage::fake('local');
    config()->set('vaulter.dedup.scope', 'tenant');
    Carbon::setTestNow('2026-06-30 12:00:00');
    // Floor the orphan grace to 1h so a 48h-old seeded object is comfortably past it.
    config()->set('vaulter.gc.orphan_grace_hours', 1);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphans с orphan → FAILURE и объект в выводе', function (): void {
    $orphanKey = CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'cmd orphan', scope: 't1', ageHours: 48);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile', ['--orphans' => true])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('Orphan walk (report-only)')
        ->expectsOutputToContain($orphanKey)
        ->assertExitCode(Command::FAILURE);

    // Report-only never deletes.
    Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($orphanKey);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphans --prune на sqlite: отказ, байты живы, FAILURE', function (): void {
    $orphanKey = CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'cmd prune refused', scope: 't1', ageHours: 48);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile', ['--orphans' => true, '--prune' => true])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('Orphan pruning needs PostgreSQL/MySQL')
        ->assertExitCode(Command::FAILURE);

    // The prune was refused on sqlite — the orphan bytes survive.
    Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($orphanKey);
})->skip(
    fn (): bool => DB::connection()->getDriverName() !== 'sqlite',
    'the FAILURE exit is the SQLite prune-refusal premise; PG/MySQL prune succeeds.',
);

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphans на чистом диске → SUCCESS', function (): void {
    // No orphan seeded — a clean disk reconciles cleanly.
    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile', ['--orphans' => true])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('Orphan walk (report-only)')
        ->assertExitCode(Command::SUCCESS);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphans: не-listable драйвер сообщает "listing unsupported", не падает на этом', function (): void {
    // A genuine aged orphan is present, but the active store cannot enumerate — the
    // walk is skipped cleanly; with no dangling row the command still SUCCEEDs.
    CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'unwalkable cmd', scope: 't1', ageHours: 48);
    app()->instance(ContentStore::class, new NonListableContentStore);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile', ['--orphans' => true, '--prune' => true])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('does not support listing')
        ->assertExitCode(Command::SUCCESS);
});

it('vaulter:blobs:reconcile --orphan-grace переопределяет окно (свежий объект не orphan)', function (): void {
    // A 2h-old object: past the 1h floor, but a 24h --orphan-grace keeps it fresh.
    CasTestHelpers::seedOrphan(bytes: 'within override grace', scope: 't1', ageHours: 2);

    $this->artisan('vaulter:blobs:reconcile', ['--orphans' => true, '--orphan-grace' => 24])
        ->expectsOutputToContain('grace 24h')
        ->assertExitCode(Command::SUCCESS);
});
